annotations.title: Edge Skills: benchmark skills on your tasks

description: Measure whether skills actually help on real tasks: runs the tasks with each given skill and with no skill, using the local claude or codex CLI subscription, then grades every run blindly with the task's grader. Pass one skill to compare it against no skill; pass several to rank them all against no skill on the same leaderboard (mean, 95% CI, paired lift vs no-skill, runs, tokens, time). Skills are Edge catalog references (owner/repo@skill) or local skill paths. Tasks come from the user (inline or a JSONL task file), or from a category so Edge suggests one by default; use task_count=3 when the user asks for three. NEVER runs immediately: the first call returns the plan, its cost (tasks × conditions × runs) and a confirmation token; show the plan to the user, and only after an explicit yes call again with the same arguments and that confirmation_token. Results stay on this machine under ~/.config/edge/evals/; only scores, category, skill ids, run counts and agent/model are shared with Edge.

agent.description: Local agent CLI to spawn; defaults to whichever is installed

category.description: A task category (e.g. security-review) so Edge suggests one task by default for the user to review

confirm.description: Not enough on its own: running needs confirmation_token from a plan the user approved.

confirmation_token.description: The confirmation token printed by the plan call. Pass it only after showing that plan to the user and getting an explicit yes; it runs exactly that plan, once.

model.description: Model override for the local CLI; defaults to the CLI's configured model

runs.description: Repetitions per task and condition (default 1 for a single skill, 2 when comparing several)

skills.description: Skills to evaluate; each is 'none', an Edge catalog reference like owner/repo@skill, or a local path to a skill directory or SKILL.md. A no-skill baseline condition is added automatically.

task_count.description: For category suggestions only: one task by default, or three when the user asks for more evidence

task_file.description: Path to a JSONL task file (one task per line, same shape as inline tasks)

tasks.description: Inline tasks, each with a grader. Use for the user's real task.

name: benchmark
